tool.hwmon_temperatures.title: Hardware Temperatures
tool.hwmon_temperatures.description: Read-only listing of every hwmon temperature sensor (temp*_input, milli-celsius → celsius).
tool.hwmon_fans.title: Hardware Fan Speeds
tool.hwmon_fans.description: Read-only listing of every hwmon fan speed (fan*__input, RPM).
tool.hwmon_voltages.title: Hardware Voltages
tool.hwmon_voltages.description: Read-only listing of every hwmon voltage (in*_input, milli-volt → volts).
tool.hwmon_power.title: RAPL Package Power
tool.hwmon_power.description: Read-only RAPL package average power (watts) from energy_uj delta vs. previous sample; first call establishes baseline.
tool.hwmon_battery.title: Battery Status
tool.hwmon_battery.description: Read-only BAT0 status and capacity; missing battery returns empty list.
tool.hwmon_thermal_zones.title: Thermal Zones
tool.hwmon_thermal_zones.description: Read-only listing of every thermal_zone* (milli-celsius → celsius).
